purpose: Primary-source sufficiency review for 2V; geometric diagnostics do not certify the mounting contract

direct_facts.finding: Member selection and fixing schemes are determined per project.
The type1 section illustrates one of its possible variants, not a complete universally interchangeable assembly.
Horizontal section shows KR2, PP, UK, GP, anchor and riveted links; no complete DOF/working-travel contract follows.
Vertical section specifies extender plates U2/U, positions3.1/3.3, not UK position3.2. It cannot silently supply the full vertical UK connection detail.
Continuous member diagrams have different upper and intermediate support symbols; no one-to-one mapping to each real KR2-UK-GP connection is established.
L1 is used as tributary length. The formula does not automatically become total-member gravity at one chosen support.
Reference calculation includes wind transfer; stiffness and permissible displacement of each real support remain unidentified.
Both reference checks use Np and Nv together for shear/bearing; their fastener assumptions are project-scoped, not a universal mounting BOM.

Page10 names two-span while using0.100/0.00675; page11 names three-span with the same coefficients. This is not an unambiguous geometry-to-coefficient rule or a newly proved project-calculation failure.

hypotheses_not_promoted_to_rules.hypothesis: One top support carries the entire member gravity while every other support is vertically sliding
hypotheses_not_promoted_to_rules.why: Support-symbol meaning, actual connection mapping and complete gravity tributary lengths are not supplied as a closed contract.

hypotheses_not_promoted_to_rules.hypothesis: Every bracket carries an independent L1 tributary gravity strip
hypotheses_not_promoted_to_rules.why: The formula uses L1 but does not close real support kinematics and reaction distribution.

hypotheses_not_promoted_to_rules.hypothesis: A rivet implies perfectly rigid restraint in every translational and rotational direction
hypotheses_not_promoted_to_rules.why: Fastener presence alone does not provide the complete connection constitutive model.
